text:
Anya: Thanks all — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the outage. I posted the RCA here: https://redwood.company/rca/INC-2026-042. Can we use this thread to capture owners for the action items, update runbooks, and agree a customer comms plan? :clipboard:

David: I'll take ownership of the KV cache change rollback and a postmortem test plan. ETA for rollback plan doc: EOD tomorrow. :+1:

Marta: I'll update the oncall runbook with the new detection steps and threshold numbers (stall-rate > 2% for 5m) by Friday. Will add a verification checklist. :wrench:

Sam: Who owns customer comms? We should have a short statement ready for customers in the affected tier. I can draft one if somebody signs off. :speech_balloon:

Jess: I can review the draft and coordinate sending. Also proposing an additional alert that catches degraded KV cache hit patterns — I can add a Grafana alert.

Anya: Great — so owners are: David (rollback + plan), Marta (runbook), Sam (comms draft), Jess (alert + send). I'll follow up with legal/PR for signoff. Can each of you add a 1-line ETA below so I can put together an action tracker?

David: Rollback runbook + smoke tests by 2026-03-27 18:00 UTC. Will put the rollback steps in `docs/infra/kv-rollback.md` and add the smoke test commands:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy
curl -sS https://internal-status/health | jq .cache_hit_rate
```

Marta: Runbook updated by 2026-03-28 12:00 UTC. Adding detection, mitigation, and post-fix validation sections.

Sam: Comms draft 1 by 2026-03-27 20:00 UTC. Will post here for review and tag Legal/PR.

Jess: Grafana alert + dashboard panel by 2026-03-27 22:00 UTC. Rule: `sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) > 0.02` and a playbook link.

IncBot: Created task INC-2026-042-ACTIONS and assigned to David, Marta, Sam, Jess. Link: https://redwood.company/tasks/INC-2026-042-ACTIONS.

Anya: Quick clarifying Qs from leadership Q&A that I want captured: 1) Are we changing SLOs for the public hosted tier? 2) Will there be any immediate capacity reservations for Dedicated customers as mitigation?

David: No SLO change planned today — we'll propose a guardrail tweak if the regression persists after rollback.

Marta: For Dedicated customers we have a manual mitigation play (node pinning + capacity bump). Ops team to confirm whether we should proactively contact high-usage customers.

Sam: I'll coordinate a short customer note template (status + ETA + mitigation) once Legal signs off. Will tag affected customers list in the draft.

Jess: Also re: monitoring, ops wants a 7-day elevated watch for regression signals. Suggest daily check-ins for the next week and a quick dashboard snapshot in this thread each morning. :calendar:

Anya: Perfect. Final asks: everyone please drop a link to your updated docs here when done. I'll compile into a single action tracker and ping leads for a 48h sync. Thanks all. :pray:
